purpose: Separate native global-policy acceptance from catalog keyword matching.
scope: file-backed fixture; real Codex workflow execution, not production-project acceptance or a model benchmark

cases.entry: fresh native root session with normal installed global policy
cases.prompt: 修复这个问题汇总工具的两个问题：状态统计会漏算同一状态的多条记录；优先级排序把小写 p1 排到后面。保留同优先级记录的原始顺序，不要修改输入数据，也不要改现有测试和命令行接口。完成后验证结果。
expected: The root discovers the standing policy without prompt references to models, Skills, or delegation.
The root selects a supported executor model and effort and a bounded ownership contract.
Assigned executors do not create further agents or promote themselves to root.
All independently bounded implementation belongs to executors; root concurrent work is analysis, control, and validation, not another independent implementation.
Actual source changes fix the frozen failing cases.
The root reviews the diff and reports verification; independent outer verification passes.

limitations: These are bounded acceptance observations, not guarantees across every task, model, or future runtime.
Catalog trigger scores do not evaluate the global forced-load route.
Do not substitute a prompt that instructs the model to use a named executor or Skill.
Freeze baseline test and metadata hashes before execution; changing them invalidates acceptance.
